newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Pacific to acquire Lykes Lines.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Pacific to acquire Lykes Lines.

text.p: Canadian Pacific Ltd said on Monday it signed a letter of intent to acquire the services of Lykes Lines, the U.S. container shipping operations of Lykes Bros Steamship Co Inc.

CP said it intends to keep the U.S.-flag ships under U.S. flag and U.S. control and to offer the Lykes services based in Tampa, Florida as a self-sustained operating unit of the CP Ships Group, which also includes Canada Maritime and Cast.
The deal includes Lykes' four owned and seven chartered ships and its container fleet. Closing is expected early in the second quarter off 1997, CP said.
CP said the acquisition will be an integral part of the reorganisation plan for Lykes, which since October 1995 has been operating under chapter 11 of the U.S. bankruptcy code.
Lykes operates container services in trades linking the U.S. with North Europe, the Mediterranean and Africa.
